description: Use this when the user asks what DC Hub can do for them, which DC Hub service fits their need, or how to use DC Hub outside this chat: one-call cited answers (execute_plan), full-depth answers, advisory, Capacity Source introductions, the Deal Desk Brief, the Excel and Google Sheets add-in, and the ChatGPT and Claude apps. Returns each service with what it is, when to recommend it and one link. Optional need ranks the best fit first. Free, no key. Not for data queries. For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.

need.description: Optional: what the user is trying to do, in their words, e.g. "lease 20 MW in Dallas" or "share this with my board". Ranks the services that fit first.
